items.exampleEn: He insisted on paying for dinner.
The plan was a complete failure.
She ignored my message all day.
items.exampleZh: 她一整天都不理我的訊息。

items.exampleEn: Students should engage in class discussions.
items.exampleZh: 學生應該參與課堂討論。

items.exampleEn: She has committed herself to learning Japanese this year.
items.exampleZh: 她今年決心全心投入學日文。

items.exampleEn: The internet connection here is very slow.
We extended our stay by two days.
items.exampleZh: 我們把停留時間延長了兩天。

items.exampleEn: The new phone combines a camera and a music player.
items.exampleZh: 這支新手機結合了相機和音樂播放器。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't ignore emails from customers.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要忽略客戶寄來的電子郵件。

items.audioEn: The library has extended its opening hours, so now it closes at ten.
items.audioZh: 圖書館延長了開放時間，所以現在十點才關門。

items.sentenceEn: There is a strong connection between sleep and health.
items.sentenceZh: 睡眠和健康之間有密切的關係。

items.sentenceEn: He insists that he locked the door this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 他堅持說他今天早上有鎖門。

items.stemEn: The new phone ____ a camera and a music player in one.
items.stemZh: 這支新手機把相機和音樂播放器結合在一起。

items.stemEn: One ____ does not mean you will never succeed.
items.stemZh: 一次失敗不代表你永遠不會成功。

items.passageEn: Sam wanted to open a small cafe that combines books and coffee. His first try was a failure because the shop was too far from the station. Many friends told him to give up, but he ignored them and insisted on trying again. This time, he engaged in conversations with customers online and built a strong connection with local readers. Business was so good that he extended the opening hours to midnight. Sam says you must commit to your dream if you want to succeed.
items.passageZh: Sam 想開一家結合書和咖啡的小咖啡店。他第一次嘗試失敗了，因為店離車站太遠。很多朋友勸他放棄，但他不理會，堅持再試一次。這次他在網路上和顧客聊天交流，和當地的讀者建立了緊密的關係。生意好到他把營業時間延長到半夜。Sam 說，想成功就必須全心投入自己的夢想。

questions.questionZh: Sam 第一次開店為什麼失敗？
生意變好後，Sam 做了什麼？
options: 把營業時間延長到半夜
在別的地方開了第二家店
賣更多種類的咖啡和甜點

items.promptZh: 你不應該忽視這個問題。
referenceEn: You should not ignore this problem.
rubricZh: ignore 表示「忽視」，後面直接接受詞（例如 ignore this problem）
「不應該」可寫 should not、shouldn't 等
寫 must not 語氣較強，也可接受

items.instructionZh: 用 combine 造一個句子，說說你喜歡把哪兩樣東西結合在一起。
referenceEn: I like to combine work and travel.
I often combine music with exercise in the morning.
rubricZh: combine 表示「結合」，例如 combine A and B、combine A with B 等說法
說的是自己的喜好、習慣等（例如 I、my）
like to＋原形動詞或 like＋動名詞都正確（例如 like to combine、like combining）
